title: Spoken output artifact
description: An A2A artifact carrying user-facing spoken output, streamed via TaskArtifactUpdateEvent (spec §6.2). Also the shape used by the say_exactly and convey directives on the artifact channel (spec §7); those additionally carry directive metadata (see directive-metadata.schema.json) with renderMode verbatim/paraphrase. Each chunk SHOULD contain both a normalized TextPart (for TTS) and a transcript TextPart (for history/UI); an untagged text part is interpreted as transcript.
